# Notes on sleep and memory

## Why sleep matters

During deep sleep the brain replays the day's experiences, and the
hippocampus hands recent memories over to the cortex for long-term
storage. People who sleep after learning remember more the next day than
people who stay awake for the same time.

## Stages

- Slow-wave sleep supports facts and events.
- REM sleep seems to help with skills and emotional memories.

## Open questions

How much of this holds for naps? Short naps help a little, but the
evidence is mixed.
